types.name: scalars
types.about: every scalar the format carries, at its extremes

types.name: scalars-zero
types.about: every field at its zero, so the message is the root byte alone

types.name: scalars-float-trim
types.about: a float whose low mantissa bytes elide

types.name: arrays
types.about: the VEC class at every element width, and the string array

types.name: optionals-nil
types.about: every pointer nil, which costs nothing at all

types.name: optionals-zero
types.about: every pointer at a zero, which is written to say it is there

types.name: nested
types.about: a struct inside a struct: another key run, not a sub-table

types.name: list
types.about: a slice of structs under the table threshold, so a LIST

types.name: list-one
types.about: a one-element list, which is where an off-by-one shows

types.name: list-empty
types.about: an empty slice, omitted like any other zero

types.name: table
types.about: a slice of all-integer structs past the threshold, so a TABLE

types.name: table-at-threshold
types.about: exactly the row count where the layout changes

types.name: table-below-threshold
types.about: one row short of it, so the same type is a LIST

types.name: table-wide
types.about: a table long enough for the column codec to have something to do

types.name: table-of-wide-rows
types.about: a narrow parent's table of wide rows, whose columns keep eight-bit keys

types.name: paged
types.about: fields on three pages, merged into one object

types.name: paged-first-page
types.about: the later pages empty, so not written, and their fields zeros

types.name: maps
types.about: one entry each, which keeps the case about a map's framing

types.name: wide
types.about: an id past sixteen, which four key bits cannot carry; an untagged field and an `any` field are the other two things that widen a key

types.name: corpus-user
types.about: the ordinary flat record

types.name: corpus-product
types.about: strings, an array of them, and a price in cents

types.name: corpus-store
types.about: the only corpus table with floats in it

types.name: corpus-metric
types.about: three integers, which is what the column codec was written for

types.name: corpus-category
types.about: three fields, two of them small integers

types.name: corpus-sale-list
types.about: a sale whose detail is under the table threshold

types.name: corpus-sale-table
types.about: a sale whose detail is transposed into columns

packed.name: packed-narrow
packed.about: the opt-in encoding under four-bit keys, through the blob header's escapes

packed.name: packed-wide
packed.about: the same strings under eight-bit keys, through the descriptor's enc
packed.json: {"Name":"Steel Lamp","SKU":"SKU-99999","Far":"a string under a key past fifteen"}

packed.name: packed-long
packed.about: a payload past the one-byte size, so the four-byte escape is used

packed.name: packed-unpackable
packed.about: strings the packed form would not shrink, written raw beside packed ones

packed.name: packed-empty
packed.about: an empty string is not written at all, packed or not

packed.name: packed-corpus-user
packed.about: a real record with the encoding on

packed.name: packed-corpus-product
packed.about: strings and an array of them, with the encoding on
